intro.title: Recursive TreeView
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a Recursive TreeView component in Angular, which visually displays hierarchical data like a file system or organizational chart. You will learn how to use recursion, a programming technique where a component calls itself to handle nested structures. The main technologies involved are Angular components, TypeScript interfaces for defining tree node data, and Angular's template syntax for conditional rendering. By the end, you will understand how to create a dynamic, self-repeating UI component that can handle any depth of nested data.
intro.usecase: Recursive TreeView patterns are essential for displaying hierarchical data in enterprise applications. You'll find them in file explorers like VS Code's sidebar, where folders contain subfolders and files in nested structures. They're also used in organizational charts, nested comment threads on platforms like Reddit, and category navigation menus in e-commerce sites where categories have subcategories. As an Angular developer, you'll implement these to create scalable navigation systems and data management interfaces that users can expand and collapse intuitively.
